svg.title: Figure S-0-1. The system folder on the systems-engineering Vee
svg.desc: The system folder's work products placed on the systems-engineering Vee: Stakeholder needs and requirements (NASA 1): WP-C-01, WP-C-02, WP-C-03, WP-C-05, WP-C-08, WP-C-09, WP-S-01; System requirements (NASA 2): WP-S-01, WP-S-02, WP-S-06, WP-S-07, WP-C-04, WP-C-10; Architecture, design and analysis (NASA 3, 4): WP-S-03, WP-S-05, WP-S-04, WP-S-07, folder:08-analyses; Implementation (NASA 5): folder:04-hardware, folder:05-software; Integration (NASA 6): WP-S-08, WP-V-05; Verification (NASA 7): WP-S-09; Validation (NASA 8): WP-V-01, WP-V-02, WP-V-03, WP-V-04, WP-V-06; Transition, operation, maintenance, disposal (NASA 9): WP-S-06, WP-K-06, WP-O-01, WP-O-02, WP-O-04, WP-O-05.
svg.text: Figure S-0-1. The system folder on the systems-engineering Vee
Circles: NASA SE-engine process (NPR 7123.1). Orange: work products in this folder. Dashed: the right stage checks the left.
Informative alignment with the INCOSE SE Handbook (5th ed.) and NASA/SP-2016-6105 Rev 2; ISO 26262 and ASPICE govern.
This folder: WP-S-01, WP-S-02, WP-S-06, WP-S-07
This folder: WP-S-03, WP-S-05, WP-S-04, WP-S-07

Elsewhere: WP-K-06, WP-O-01, WP-O-02, WP-O-04, WP-O-05
Technical management (NASA SE engine 10–17; ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 technical management)
